limitations: Finite standard-Z non-oblique cameras only; no infinite/reversed-Z projection support claimed
Four fixed cascades; 256/512/1024 texels per cascade; fixed 3x3 bilinear-equivalent PCF (16 shared depth fetches)
Rigid opaque/MASK meshes only; actual triangles cast shadows; smooth-normal terminators, contact bias and thin-surface quality need owner review
All overlapping caster bounds extend depth, including downstream casters; large scenes/outliers can reduce precision and collection/fitting cost is not optimized
Fixed-light/projection stability only; moving light basis can switch near its up-axis threshold; FOV/split/distance changes can reallocate/rescale
No point/spot shadows, PCSS, contact hardening, world-2D casting or production update cache
provenance: Preliminary nearest-PCF strict parity failed at four edge pixels; continuous PCF fixed it without loosening the .003 RGB gate
